latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Generator In Video — generate polished videos from your footage in minutes, no editing skills required.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB and describe your desired video; AI generates highlight reels, adds transitions, and background music automatically.
- Seamless cloud pipeline: video processing, timeline edits, and rendering handled server-side with quick turnaround.
- Simple session and token handling: automatic sign-in via environment variable or free trial token.
- Supports essential user actions: upload, export, check credits, view session status.
- Error handling and supported file formats clearly guided for easy troubleshooting.
